lesson.grammar_point: verb to be (affirmative: am / is / are)

listenings.text: Good morning, and welcome to Sun Bank. My name is Paul Adams. I am a manager here in Miami. This office is new. Today we are ten people in the office. My job is money and business, and I am happy in this job. My English is American English. It is not fast. Welcome, and have a good day.

Hello, Ricardo. This is Diane. I am at the office now, in Miami. Our meeting is on Monday. My name is on the door: Diane Foster, manager. Your name is on my list too. This is a good day for the bank and for you. See you on Monday. Thank you, and good night.

extra_audio.text: Ricardo is in the office in São Paulo. He says his name to Diane. He says his job: he is a manager. He says his bank and his office. Diane says welcome to Miami.
